title: Termination, Discharge and Fee End Date — Assisted Living Residency and Care Agreement
content:
**Article on the end of the residency.**

**1. Notice of termination.** A resident ends the Assisted Living Residency and Care Agreement by a written notice of termination signed by the resident or by a representative whose authority on the customer profile is a financial power of attorney, a durable power of attorney or guardianship. The same signing authority applies to a withdrawal of the notice.

**2. Withdrawal of a notice.** A notice may be withdrawn only before the intended vacate date stated on it. The withdrawal window is counted in calendar days and closes at the end of the day before the intended vacate date; the cutoff is 0 days before that date, so a withdrawal on the intended vacate date itself is outside the window.

**3. Fee end date.** Rent and care fees run through a fee end date:
- after a resident notice, the later of the vacate date and the notice date plus the resident notice period (30 calendar days);
- on death, the later of the vacate date and the date of death on the customer profile plus the post-death fee period (7 calendar days);
- on a transfer into Larkspur memory care, the day before the memory care move-in date, the internal transfer notice period being 0;
- after a discharge, the vacate date.

**4. Discharge.** A discharge notice for nonpayment may be issued only after a charge has remained past due for the past-due period before discharge (45 days). A discharge for nonpayment or because the resident's needs exceed assisted living takes effect only after a written discharge notice issued by the executive director, and the residency may be ended for discharge only once the discharge notice period (30 calendar days) has passed since that notice. The discharge period is counted in calendar days from the notice date recorded on the residency, and the residency may be ended on the notice date plus 30 calendar days or later.

**5. Refund of days after the fee end date.** Days after the fee end date in a month already billed are returned as move-out proration credits referencing that month's rent and care fee charges; the community fee is never refunded.

### Worked cases (hypothetical dates)

| Ending | Facts | Fee end date |
|---|---|---|
| Resident notice | Notice 10 March, vacate 25 March | 9 April (10 March plus 30 days is later than 25 March) |
| Resident notice | Notice 10 March, vacate 20 April | 20 April |
| Death | Date of death 4 May, belongings removed 8 May | 11 May (4 May plus 7 days is later than 8 May) |
| Transfer to memory care | Memory care move-in 16 June | 15 June |
| Discharge | Vacate 30 June | 30 June |

| Withdrawal of a notice with intended vacate date 31 May | Within the window |
|---|---|
| Signed 30 May | Yes |
| Signed 31 May | No |

| Discharge notice recorded 1 May | May the residency be ended for discharge? |
|---|---|
| 30 May | No (day 29) |
| 31 May | Yes (day 30) |
